description: An armored black headset that coalesces the feeds of several sensors into a single screen display.  It will periodically expose weaknesses in the armor of enemies within 15 tiles and provide passive targeting assistance for as long as it is active.  It can be upgraded with modules to provide additional functionality.

use_action.msg: You lower the visor and flick the control dial to active.

use_action.msg: You flick the visor off, and push it off your face.

description:
It used to be that marksmanship was a real skill, honed over arduous years spent killing farmhands while hiding in a ditch somewhere.  Now, thanks to tech, anyone can drop a few grand and be an unhinged psycho killer. This one is 11th gen, with six high definition cameras and movement prediction algorithms ensure that you'll nail gatekeepers from miles away.

It will periodically expose weaknesses in the armor of threats beyond 25 tiles and provide passive targeting assistance for as long as it is active.

use_action.msg: You lower the visor.  Green pixels dance from the edges of the screen as the HUD comes online.

description: An opaque lune of dark alloy encases the wearer's identity, leaving only an inhuman visage marked by the indentures of a high gain microphone.  It has but a single HUD mode, which utilizes EM-spectrum sensors and a SONAR array to reconstruct a visual feed in which figures are tagged as hostile, friendly, or irrelevant. Its detection capabilities clearly demarcates contacts through smoke and most solid obstacles, allowing users with the proper equipment to dispatch foes without ever exposing themselves to danger.  It must be active to function.

use_action.msg: The OmniWare screen flickers to life, bathing your vision in blue noise before coalescing into a clear feed.

passive_effects.description: Passively detects movement at 6 second intervals.

use_action.msg: The OmniWare screen flickers off with a brief flash, leaving you in darkness.
